top_stories.title: Microsoft Build 2026: The 7 biggest announcements
top_stories.summary: Microsoft's Build 2026 conference brought a wave of AI announcements including the launch of its first advanced reasoning model MAI Thinking 1, the Scout personal AI assistant built on OpenClaw, Project Solara (an OS for AI agent gadgets), and new Windows features. The company also unveiled the Surface RTX Spark dev box and multiple agentic AI tools aimed at enterprise and consumer users.

top_stories.title: Trump signs executive order to review AI models before they're released
top_stories.summary: President Trump has signed an executive order requiring review of AI models prior to public release, marking a significant step in US federal AI governance. The order comes after weeks of internal reversals and reflects ongoing tensions within the Trump administration over how to regulate AI.

top_stories.title: AI outperforms law professors in Stanford Law study
top_stories.summary: A new study from Stanford Law School found that AI systems outperformed law professors on a range of legal tasks. The findings raise significant questions about the future role of legal expertise and the potential for AI to reshape the legal profession.

top_stories.title: Uber caps employee AI spending after blowing through budget in four months
top_stories.summary: Uber has placed a cap on employee AI tool spending after its workforce exhausted the allocated annual budget in just four months. The move highlights the rapid and sometimes uncontrolled adoption of AI tools within large enterprises.

top_stories.title: Codex is becoming a productivity tool for everyone
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has published a post outlining how its Codex tool is expanding beyond software developers to serve as a general productivity assistant for knowledge workers across different roles and workflows. The announcement signals OpenAI's push to broaden Codex adoption into enterprise settings.

further_links.title: The Trump Administration Is at War With Itself Over AI Regulation
further_links.summary: Wired reports on internal divisions within the Trump White House over how to approach AI regulation, with competing factions pushing different policy directions. [Metered]

further_links.title: Microsoft's first advanced reasoning AI is here
further_links.summary: Microsoft has unveiled MAI Thinking 1, its first in-house advanced reasoning AI model, announced at Build 2026.

further_links.title: Gemini Spark is the most impressive and terrifying AI experience I've had yet
further_links.summary: The Verge's hands-on with Gemini Spark describes a highly capable agentic AI experience for trip planning that raised both excitement and concern about autonomous AI behaviour.

further_links.title: Travelers deploys AI-powered claims countrywide with OpenAI
further_links.summary: Insurance company Travelers has announced a nationwide deployment of AI-powered claims processing built with OpenAI, representing a large-scale enterprise rollout of generative AI.

further_links.title: Codex for every role, tool, and workflow
further_links.summary: OpenAI details how Codex is being extended to integrate with a wide range of professional tools and workflows beyond software development.

further_links.title: Google's Phone app will tell you if a scammer is impersonating one of your contacts
further_links.summary: Google is adding a scam detection feature to its Phone app that uses AI to flag when a caller may be impersonating someone in a user's contacts.

further_links.title: Meet Microsoft Scout, Your AI Coworker That Never Logs Off
further_links.summary: Wired profiles Microsoft's newly announced Scout AI personal assistant, which is built on the OpenClaw model and designed to act as a persistent, always-on work companion. [Metered]

further_links.title: More than 6 out of 10 people turn to AI for psychological support
further_links.summary: AXA's 2026 Mind Health Report finds that the majority of people surveyed are now turning to AI tools for psychological support, raising questions about the role of AI in mental health care.

further_links.title: How small businesses can leverage AI
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review examines practical strategies for small businesses to adopt and benefit from AI tools, including administrative automation. [Metered]

further_links.title: Americans don't know how to fight AI so they're fighting data centers
further_links.summary: Vox reports on a growing grassroots movement in the US where communities are pushing back against AI infrastructure by opposing local data center construction.
